written.headline: Large flow language model Lafa scaled to 8 B parameters with 2.5× faster inference
written.summary: Researchers introduced Lafa, an 8‑billion‑parameter continuous flow language model trained on fewer than 30 billion tokens. The model matches or exceeds autoregressive quality while achieving 2.54× higher throughput via self‑speculative decoding.

written.headline: NVIDIA expands Confidential Computing with Confidential Bare Metal for model builders
written.summary: NVIDIA announced Confidential Bare Metal, a new deployment option for its Confidential Computing platform that lets frontier model builders run sensitive workloads on dedicated third‑party bare‑metal infrastructure while retaining control of models and data. The expansion adds platform security controls, support across Grace Blackwell and Rubin systems, and integrations such as Cohere’s Model Vault and Google Cloud’s A4X Max instances.

written.headline: Mistral and Mozilla launch AI‑powered Firefox Smart Window beta
written.summary: Mistral announced a partnership with Mozilla to power the Firefox Smart Window beta browsing assistant with its models. The service will initially serve users in France and North America, with the United Kingdom and Germany expected to follow later this year.
